name: ECG + Echo (heart tests)
note: First tests for most heart problems

name: Coronary angiography
note: Shows whether heart arteries are blocked

name: Angioplasty with stent
note: Stent prices are capped by the government (NPPA) - ask for the itemised bill

name: Heart bypass surgery (CABG)
note: Major decision - get a second opinion first

name: X-ray / MRI knee
note: Confirms how badly the joint is damaged

name: Physiotherapy course (10 sessions)
note: Often tried before or after joint and spine treatment

name: Knee replacement (one knee)
note: Major decision - get a second opinion first

name: Kidney stone surgery (URS / PCNL)
note: Small stones sometimes pass with medicines - ask first

name: Cataract surgery (one eye)
note: Free at many government hospitals and eye camps

name: MRI spine
note: Usually needed before any spine surgery decision

name: Spine disc surgery (discectomy)
note: Major decision - get a second opinion first
